_notes: API key/secret are NOT stored here. Either export ONSHAPE_API_KEY / ONSHAPE_API_SECRET in your shell, or put them in ~/.config/onshape-to-robot/config.json .
Output will be  robot.urdf  plus meshes in this folder; we'll move/rename into assets/gripper_so100_tactile/ afterwards.
If the sensor pad body in Onshape is named explicitly, add  "mergeSTLs": "visual"  or  "noFrames": []  to preserve the Wrist_Roll_08c link as its own URDF link.
